body:
## Summary
- Bump the canonical Sepo package/runtime version to `0.3.1` in `.agent/package.json` and `.agent/package-lock.json`.
- Add `.agent/CHANGELOG.md` release notes for the patch fixes and hardening since `v0.3.0`.
- Confirm no additional version-specific docs or checklist entries needed updates.

## Version Validation
- `0.3.1` was requested in #402.
- It is valid package SemVer without the leading `v`; the corresponding release tag would be `v0.3.1` per `.agent/docs/technical-details/versioning.md`.
- This PR prepares source changes only. No git tags, GitHub Releases, or package publications were created.

## Verification
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/release-version.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/prepare-release-cli.test.js`
- `node -e "const { parseReleaseVersion } = require('./.agent/dist/release-version.js'); const parsed = parseReleaseVersion('0.3.1'); if (parsed.version !== '0.3.1' || parsed.tag !== 'v0.3.1') process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify(parsed));"`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #402
title: Prepare Sepo 0.3.1 release
